split-medium-8.label: split-medium-8
split-medium-8.matching: Explicit authored benchmark round and writer, request and numbered batch. Same-isolate monotonic timestamps; no wall-clock conversion or ordinal pairing.
split-medium-8.limits: SQL includes transport and scheduling. Connection includes BEGIN. Client frame boundaries use the round clock. Split transport residual includes both network directions and uninstrumented SDK/server boundaries, not a pure RTT or one-way measurement. No invalid residual is clamped.
